freeze_order: Teacher phrases committed before any evaluation descriptions for ranks 101-200 were authored or retrieved.
purpose: Blind-between-artifacts test of whether model-authored build-time semantic language generalizes to disjoint targets and later-authored natural descriptions while runtime remains deterministic BM25/postings.
constraints: No retrieval results for ranks 101-200 are consulted while authoring teacher phrases.
Evaluation queries are authored only after this teacher artifact is frozen.
Evaluation queries must not equal a teacher phrase and must not contain the full canonical preferred label.
Raw benchmark scores are immutable; all misses/regressions plus a deterministic sample of hits are adjudicated separately.
